name: FrontierCode
intro: FrontierCode 是 Cognition 于 2026 年发布的生产级软件工程基准，检验代码智能体提交的 PR 是否真正可合并。150 个真实开源仓库任务由 20+ 位维护者构建，评分同时覆盖正确性、回归安全、构建与风格、测试、改动范围和代码质量；1.1 版以 Main 100 题和 Extended 150 题报告结果。
build_method: 开源维护者构建, 对抗式评分加固, 多阶段人工评审
metric: 通过率, 加权评分标准分
task_type: 智能体软件工程, 仓库级代码修改
eval_feature: 可合并性, 代码质量, blocker 标准, 公平联网检查
scale: 150 题, 36 个开源仓库, 1,000+ 评分标准
task_type_en: Agentic Software Engineering, Repository-level Code Modification
build_method_en: Open-source maintainer authoring, adversarial rubric hardening, multi-stage human review
eval_feature_en: Mergeability, Code Quality, Blocker Criteria, Fair Internet-use Verification
intro_en: FrontierCode is Cognition's 2026 production-quality software-engineering benchmark for whether a coding agent's pull request is truly mergeable. Its 150 real open-source tasks are built by 20+ maintainers and grade correctness, regression safety, build and style, tests, scope, and code quality; version 1.1 reports the 100-task Main and 150-task Extended sets.

drawio_review_note: Aligned only to Cognition's dated official posts, Introducing FrontierCode (2026-06-08) and FrontierCode 1.1 (2026-07-07). Cognition publishes no paper, public repository, task bundle, base-commit inventory, or grader implementation, so the diagram does not infer undisclosed source filters, repository revisions, or evaluator code. The disclosed flow uses 20+ maintainers across 36 repositories, more than 40 hours per task, realistic multi-PR-chain or free-form work, concise briefs plus codebase guidelines, and mergeability criteria spanning behavior, regressions, build/lint/style, tests, scope, and code quality. Criterion types are classical, command, reverse-classical, scope, adaptive classical via mutagent, and LLM prompt grading. Quality control uses wrong and alternate-valid solutions, Devin-generated hacks, four 0–100% calibration solutions, pod review, Cognition researcher review, and re-review. The private Extended set has 150 tasks and Main the hardest 100. Version 1.1 audits 1,000+ criteria, demotes 75 blockers, adds the fair-internet-use prompt and classical verifier, and deprecates Diamond 50. Each model has five trials per reasoning effort; metrics are averaged per effort and reported at the best effort. A blocker failure or flagged unfair internet use gives the run score zero.
